packageRules.description: Bump pnpm in mise.toml and package.json's packageManager together so the pnpm mise installs matches the version pnpm switches to.

cd.yml deploys the site, so it is this repo's release job. Repeats default.json's release-job hold, which matches only release.yml; change both. Runner images are exempt because GitHub also issues that job's OIDC token.
